subject: Basalt status: TREC repro + generalization deltas
body:
Hi Dmitri, Bruno,

Status on the repro. TREC label-coarse (6 classes, seed 538, 500 steps, decay at step 200) matches the open-source release: the predicted rank vector 1,3,7,9,9,8,8,8,8,10,10,8 on value modules beats uniform rank-8 by +1.7 accuracy on unseen test data, consistent with the claim that AdaRank generalizes notably better than uniform ranks. yelp_polarity is running now at batch size 256; first numbers Friday.

Risk worth flagging: the disagreement probes add roughly 30% wall-clock ahead of adaptation. For service integration that's the number the platform team will push back on. Tereza is prototyping probe-output caching, which should cut most of it for repeated tasks.

Wei
